paragraphs: Lindblad has been providing marine expedition adventures and active travel experiences globally to its guests since 1979. Our expedition sailing and land-based adventure travel experiences foster a spirit of exploration and discovery through itineraries that feature up-close encounters with wildlife, nature, history and culture, and promote guest empowerment, human connections and interactivity. Our mission is to offer life-enhancing adventures around the world and pioneering innovative ways to allow our guests to connect with exotic and remote places. Our brands include Lindblad Expeditions, Natural Habitat, Inc. ("Natural Habitat"), Off the Beaten Path, LLC ("Off the Beaten Path"), DuVine Cycling + Adventure Company ("DuVine"), Classic Journeys, LLC ("Classic Journeys"), and Thomson Group, consisting of Wineland-Thomson Adventures, LLC ("Thomson Safaris"), Nature Discovery Ltd ("Nature Discovery"), Thomson Safaris Ltd ("Thomson Safaris Tanzania"), and Ngorongoro Safari Lodge Ltd ("Gibb's Farm").

The Lindblad segment consists primarily of ship-based expeditions aboard customized, nimble and intimately-scaled vessels that are designed for discovery, enabling us to venture where larger cruise ships cannot, thereby allowing Lindblad to offer up-close experiences in the planet's wild and remote places and capitals of culture. Many of these expeditions involve travel to remote places with limited infrastructure and ports, such as Antarctica and the Arctic, or places that are best accessed by a ship, such as the Galápagos Islands, Alaska and Baja California's Sea of Cortez and foster active engagement by guests. Each expedition ship is fully equipped with state-of-the-art tools for in-depth exploration.

We choose to visit geographic areas based upon many factors, including weather, marine conditions, migration patterns and various natural phenomena and are continually expanding our travel offerings. In the northern hemisphere summer months, we primarily visit the High Arctic regions of the world, Alaska, the Canadian Maritimes, Europe, and in the northern hemisphere winter months, we primarily travel to Antarctica, South America, Costa Rica, Baja California, Panama and the Caribbean. The Galápagos Islands are a year-round destination offering a diverse variety of marine, land and airborne wildlife.

Our offerings appeal to a wide range of travelers, both individuals and families, with affluent individuals in the U.S. aged 50 years or older representing our largest demographic category. We lead life-enhancing expeditions helping curious travelers experience the world from a new perspective. The quality of our offerings has enabled us to achieve and maintain premium pricing in the market instead of pursuing the type of discounting offered by most cruise lines that are focused on the broader market. Our product offering, value proposition and differentiated pricing approach have enabled us to historically achieve high net yields and occupancy rates.

We have a longstanding relationship with the National Geographic Society, which began in 2004, and was founded on a shared interest in exploration, research, technology and conservation. This relationship includes co-selling, co-marketing and branding arrangements with National Geographic Partners, LLC ("National Geographic") whereby our owned vessels carry the National Geographic name and National Geographic sells our expeditions through their internal travel divisions. In November 2023, this strategic partnership with National Geographic was expanded and extended through 2040. Under the new agreement, the two companies have extended their industry-defining 20-year relationship, allowing the brand to reach new worldwide audiences through compelling new market opportunities and long-term, mutually beneficial growth strategies. We collaborate with National Geographic on expedition planning and to enhance the guest experience by having National Geographic experts, including photographers, writers, marine biologists, naturalists, field researchers and film crews, join our expeditions. Guests have the ability to interact with these experts through lectures, excursions, dining and other experiences throughout their expedition.

We currently operate a fleet of 12 owned expedition vessels, along with 10 seasonal chartered ships (with several other vessels contracted for future expeditions), to provide our signature marine-based adventures to over 40 destinations on six continents, offering itineraries that last from five to over 30 days. The small size of our vessels allows them to reach places inaccessible to larger ships. They are designed with a variety of public areas that offer views for passing landscape and observing wildlife and large dining rooms and lounges that form part of the social hubs of the ships, featuring presentation space for exploration recaps.

We have extensive experience operating in the Galápagos Islands, Alaska, Antarctica and the Arctic, with the Lindblad family having been among the first to bring non-scientist travelers to these regions. We operate four vessels providing itineraries in the Galápagos Islands throughout the year. We operate three polar vessels that serve primarily in Antarctica during the northern hemisphere winter, in the Arctic and Europe during the northern hemisphere summer and various destinations during the intermediate months. We operate four ships in Alaska during the summer months that then primarily travel south along the North American Pacific coastline to Baja California's Sea of Cortez, Costa Rica and Panama for the winter. We also operate a blue water ship that sails itineraries in Antarctica, Europe, the Mediterranean Sea, the South Pacific and Asia. We continue to search for, and evaluate, distinctive locations to present new and exciting expedition itineraries for our guests.

In addition to our owned and operated ships, we deploy chartered vessels for various seasonal offerings and continually seek to optimize our charter fleet to balance our inventory with demand and maximize yields. We use our charter inventory as a mechanism to both increase travel options for our existing and prospective guests and also to test demand for certain areas and seasons to understand the potential for longer term deployments and additional vessel needs. We currently charter vessels for seasonal itineraries in the Amazon, Cambodia and Vietnam, the Caribbean, Egypt, the Mediterranean Sea, and Scotland.

headings: Risks Related to the Demand for Expedition Travel
Adverse worldwide economic conditions could reduce the demand for expedition travel and adversely impact our operating results, cash flows and financial condition.

Any restrictions on expedition travel related to health concerns or for other reasons, have materially adversely affected our business and could materially adversely affect our future financial condition and liquidity.
Risks Related to Our Business and Operations
We may lose business to competitors in the vacation market, which would negatively impact our results of operations and financial condition.
Climate change could have a material impact on our business.
Significant weather, climate events and/or natural disasters could adversely impact our business and results of operations.
Failure to maintain our Brand License Agreement with National Geographic could adversely affect our results of operations.

Ship repair, revitalization delays or mechanical issues on existing vessels may result in cancellation of expeditions or unscheduled drydockings and repairs and, thus, adversely affect our results of operations.
Delays or cost overruns or the financial difficulties of the shipyards could have a negative impact on us.
We must make substantial capital expenditures to maintain and/or expand our fleet, and we may not be able to obtain sufficient financing or capital on favorable terms or at all.
Unavailability of ports of call and expedition destinations may adversely affect our results of operations.
Any change in federal or state classifications of our workforce could materially effect our business.
Conducting business globally may result in increased costs and other risks.
Our efforts to expand our business into new markets, complete acquisitions or realize the anticipated benefits thereof may not be successful.
We have a relationship with World Wildlife Fund ("WWF"), and the termination of or alterations to this relationship may have an adverse effect on our Natural Habitat business.
Our operating costs could continue to increase due to market forces, inflation, supply chain disruptions and economic or geopolitical factors beyond our control.
Our reliance on travel advisors to sell and market our cruises exposes us to certain risks that, if realized, could adversely impact our business.
Disruptions in our shoreside operations or our information systems may adversely affect our results of operations.
Fluctuations in foreign currency exchange rates could affect our financial results.

The loss of key personnel, our inability to recruit or retain qualified personnel, or disruptions among our shipboard personnel due to strained employee relations could adversely affect our results of operations.
We rely on third-party providers of various services integral to the operation of our businesses. These third parties may act in ways that could harm our business.

Our information technology systems are subject to cyber and other risks, some of which are beyond our control, which could have a material adverse effect on our business, results of operations and financial position.
Litigation, enforcement actions, fines or penalties could adversely impact our financial condition or results of operations and/or damage our reputation.
An inability to obtain adequate insurance coverage could adversely affect our business, financial condition and results of operations.
A change in our tax status under the United States Internal Revenue Code of 1986, as amended (the "Code"), or other jurisdictions, may have adverse effects on our income.
Restrictions on travel or access to certain protected or preserved areas could adversely affect our business.
Failure to comply with data privacy and security laws and regulations could adversely affect our operating results and business.
Compliance with existing or changing laws and regulations could adversely affect our business.
Environmental, labor, health and safety, financial responsibility and other maritime regulations could affect operations and increase operating costs.
Restrictions on non-U.S. citizen ownership of certain U.S. flagged vessels could limit our ability to sell off a portion of our business or result in the forfeiture of certain of our vessels.
Our substantial debt could adversely affect our financial condition.
paragraphs: You should carefully consider the risk factors set forth below and the other information in this Annual Report on Form 10-K. The matters discussed in the risk factors, and additional risks and uncertainties not currently known to us or that we currently deem immaterial, could have a material adverse effect on our business, financial condition, results of operation and future growth prospects.

Events and conditions around the world, including geopolitical events, war and other military actions or other events impacting the ability or desire of people to travel, have led, and may in the future lead, to a decline in demand for expedition travel.

We have been, and may continue to be, impacted by the public's concerns regarding the health, safety and security of travel, including government travel advisories and travel restrictions, political instability and civil unrest, terrorist attacks, war and military action, such as the continuing conflict resulting from the Russian invasion of Ukraine, and other general concerns. The resulting impacts of these events, including supply chain disruptions, increased fuel prices, impact on demand and international sanctions and other measures that have been imposed, have adversely affected, and may continue to adversely affect, our business. Additionally, we have been, and may continue to be, impacted by heightened regulations around customs and border control, travel bans to and from certain geographical areas, voluntary changes to our itineraries in light of geopolitical events, government policies increasing the difficulty of travel and limitations on issuing international travel visas. Any of these factors could lead to a reduction in the demand for expedition travel, which would negatively impact our business.

The demand for travel experiences, including expedition cruises and land-based travel, may be adversely affected by international, national and local economic conditions. In particular, a deterioration in global economic conditions that adversely affects discretionary income and consumer confidence may, in turn, result in decreased bookings, prices and onboard revenues for the expedition and cruise industries. Uncertain economic conditions also impact consumer confidence and pose a risk as vacationers may postpone or reduce discretionary spending. We have been and may continue to be impacted by inflation, higher fuel prices, higher interest rates and supply chain disruptions and may also be impacted by adverse changes in the perceived or actual economic climate, such as global or regional recessions, higher unemployment and underemployment rates and declines in income levels.

In past recessions, demand for our expeditionary travel offerings has been significantly negatively impacted, resulting in lower occupancy rates and adverse pricing. Any economic forecasts for significant increases in unemployment in the U.S. and other regions would likely have a negative impact on demand for our expeditions, and these impacts could exist for an extensive period of time.

Incidents or adverse publicity concerning the cruise industry, the expedition travel industry or the travel industry in general, terrorist or pirate attacks, war, travel restrictions, pandemics or other disruptions could affect our reputation as well as have a negative impact on our sales and results of operations.

headings: Management's Discussion and Analysis of the Results of Operations and Financial Condition
The following metrics apply to our Lindblad segment:
Gross Cruise Cost represents the sum of cost of tours plus selling and marketing expenses, and general and administrative expenses.
Gross Yield per Available Guest Night represents tour revenues divided by Available Guest Nights.
Guest Nights Sold represents the number of guests carried for the period multiplied by the number of nights sailed within the period.
Maximum Guests is a measure of capacity and represents the maximum number of guests in a period and is based on double occupancy per cabin (except single occupancy for a single capacity cabin).
Net Cruise Cost represents Gross Cruise Cost excluding commissions and certain other direct costs of guest ticket revenues and other tour revenues.
Net Cruise Cost Excluding Fuel represents Net Cruise Cost excluding fuel costs.
Net Yield represents tour revenues less commissions and direct costs of other tour revenues.
Net Yield per Available Guest Night represents Net Yield divided by Available Guest Nights.
Number of Guests represents the number of guests that travel with us in a period.
Occupancy is calculated by dividing Guest Nights Sold by Available Guest Nights.
Voyages represent the number of ship expeditions completed during the period.
The following metrics apply to our Land Experiences segment:
Departures represent the number of trips, tours, treks and safaris completed during the period.

paragraphs: The information contained in this section should be read in conjunction with our consolidated financial statements and related notes and the information contained elsewhere in this Form 10-K under the headings "Risk Factors" and "Business."

We provide expedition cruising and land-based adventure travel fostering a spirit of exploration and discovery, using itineraries featuring up-close encounters with wildlife and nature, history and culture, and promote guest empowerment, human connections and interactivity. Our mission is to offer life-enhancing adventures around the world and pioneer innovative ways to allow our guests to connect with exotic and remote places.

We currently operate a fleet of 12 owned expedition ships and 10 seasonal charter vessels (with several other vessels contracted for future expeditions) under the Lindblad Expeditions, LLC. ("Lindblad") brand. Each expedition ship is fully equipped with state-of-the-art tools for in-depth exploration, and the majority of our expeditions involve travel to remote places, such as voyages to Alaska, the Arctic, Antarctic, the Galápagos Islands, Baja's Sea of Cortez, the South Pacific, Costa Rica and Panama. We have a longstanding relationship with the National Geographic Society ("National Geographic") dating back to 2004, which is based on a shared interest in exploration, research, technology and conservation. This relationship, which was recently expanded and extended through 2040, includes a co-selling, co-marketing and global branding arrangement whereby our owned vessels carry the National Geographic name, and National Geographic sells our expeditions through its internal travel division. We collaborate with National Geographic on voyage planning to enhance the guest experience by having National Geographic experts, including photographers, writers, marine biologists, naturalists, field researchers and film crews, join our expeditions. Guests have the ability to interact with these experts through lectures, excursions, dining and other experiences throughout their voyage.

We also operate land-based adventure travel experiences around the globe, with unique itineraries designed to offer intimate encounters with nature and the planet's remarkable destinations including the animals and people who live there.

Natural Habitat, Inc. ("Natural Habitat") provides eco-conscious expeditions and nature-focused, small-group experiences that include polar bear tours in Churchill, Canada, Alaskan grizzly bear adventures, small-group Galápagos Islands tours and African safaris. Natural Habitat has partnered with World Wildlife Fund ("WWF") to offer conservation travel, which is sustainable travel that contributes to the protection of nature and wildlife.

Off the Beaten Path, LLC ("Off the Beaten Path") provides small group travel, led by local, experienced guides, with distinct focus on wildlife, hiking national parks and culture. Off the Beaten Path offerings include insider national park experiences in the Rocky Mountains, Desert Southwest, and Alaska, as well as unique trips across Central and South America, Oceania, Europe and Africa.

DuVine Cycling + Adventure Company ("DuVine") provides intimate cycling adventures and travel experiences, led by expert guides, with a focus on connecting with local character and culture, including high-quality local cuisine and accommodations. International cycling tours include the exotic Costa Rican rainforests, the rocky coasts of Ireland and the vineyards of Spain, while cycling adventures in the United States include cycling beneath the California redwoods, pedaling through Vermont farmland and wine tastings in the world-class vineyards of Napa and Sonoma.

Classic Journeys, LLC ("Classic Journeys") offers highly curated active small-group and private custom journeys centered around cinematic walks led by expert local guides in over 50 countries around the world. These walking tours are highlighted by luxury boutique accommodations, and handcrafted itineraries that immerse guests into the history and culture of the places they are exploring and the people who live there.

Thomson Group, consisting of Wineland-Thomson Adventures, LLC ("Thomson Safaris"), Nature Discovery Ltd ("Nature Discovery"), Thomson Safaris Ltd ("Thomson Safaris Tanzania"), and Ngorongoro Safari Lodge Ltd ("Gibb's Farm"), provides socially responsible and positively impactful light-treading adventures in East Africa. They specialize in immersive safaris featuring an exclusive system of camps and expert local wildlife guides; they provide high-end treks to the summit of Kilimanjaro, the Roof of Africa; and offer luxurious stays at the award-winning Gibb's Farm, an 80-acre sanctuary located near the Ngorongoro Crater. 45 years of experience and a commitment to environmental and social responsibility make every adventure exceptional.

On January 9, 2025, we completed the acquisition of Torcatt Enterprises Limitada, a holding company that owns and operates two vessels in the Galápagos Islands, for $16.0 million in cash. The acquisition expanded our fleet and guest capacity in one of our core markets.

On August 20, 2025, we issued $675.0 million of 7.00% senior secured notes, maturing 2030, with proceeds used primarily to pay the outstanding borrowings under our prior 9.00% and 6.75% senior secured notes and increased the amount available under our revolving credit facility to $60.0 million.
On February 3, 2026, we forced the conversion of all 62,000 outstanding shares of Series A Convertible Preferred Stock into 9.0 million shares of common stock.

paragraphs: Lindblad 自 1979 年起，持續為全球的旅客提供海洋探險與活躍旅遊體驗。我們的探險帆船與陸上冒險旅遊體驗，透過行程中與野生動物、自然、歷史與文化面對面接觸，培養旅客探索與發現的精神，並促進旅客的自主性、人際連結與互動。我們的使命是為全球旅客提供提升生活品質的冒險體驗，並創新方式讓旅客與異國與偏遠地區建立連結。我們的品牌包括 Lindblad Expeditions、Natural Habitat, Inc.（"Natural Habitat"）、Off the Beaten Path, LLC（"Off the Beaten Path"）、DuVine Cycling + Adventure Company（"DuVine"）、Classic Journeys, LLC（"Classic Journeys"），以及 Thomson Group，包含 Wineland-Thomson Adventures, LLC（"Thomson Safaris"）、Nature Discovery Ltd（"Nature Discovery"）、Thomson Safaris Ltd（"Thomson Safaris Tanzania"），以及 Ngorongoro Safari Lodge Ltd（"Gibb's Farm"）。

Lindblad 分部主要由客製化、靈活且規模適中的帆船組成，這些帆船設計用於探索，使我們能前往大型郵輪無法抵達的區域，從而讓 Lindblad 提供旅客與地球野生與偏遠地區以及文化中心面對面的體驗。許多這些探險行程涉及前往基礎設施有限且港口稀少的偏遠地區，例如南極與北極，或需透過船隻才能到達的地區，例如加拉帕戈斯羣島、阿拉斯加與下加利福尼亞的科爾特斯海，並促進旅客的主動參與。每艘探險船均配備最先進的工具，用以深入探索。
我們選擇造訪的地理區域是根據許多因素，包括天氣、海洋條件、遷徙模式與各種自然現象，我們持續擴展旅遊產品。在北半球夏季，我們主要造訪全球的高緯度北極地區、阿拉斯加、加拿大東海岸與歐洲；而在北半球冬季，我們主要前往南極、南美洲、哥斯達黎加、下加利福尼亞、巴拿馬與加勒比海。加拉帕戈斯羣島是全年皆可造訪的旅遊目的地，提供多樣的海洋、陸地與空中野生動物。
我們的產品吸引廣泛的旅客，包括個人與家庭，其中美國年齡 50 歲或以上的富裕個人為我們最大的人口統計類別。我們引領提升生活品質的探險，協助好奇的旅客從新的角度體驗世界。我們產品的品質使我們能在市場中實現並維持高價位，而非追求大多數以廣泛市場為目標的郵輪公司所提供的折扣策略。我們的產品組合、價值主張與差異化定價策略使我們歷來能實現高淨收益率與入住率。

我們與國家地理學會有長期的合作關係，自 2004 年開始，並建立在對探險、研究、科技與保育的共同興趣之上。此合作關係包括與國家地理夥伴公司（"National Geographic"）的共同銷售、共同行銷與品牌合作安排，我們所有的船隻均以國家地理為名稱，國家地理透過其內部旅遊部門銷售我們的探險行程。2023 年 11 月，我們與國家地理的戰略合作關係擴展並延長至 2040 年。根據新協議，兩家公司已延長其產業定義的 20 年合作關係，讓品牌能透過強大的新市場機會，達到全球新觀眾，並實現長期、雙方受益的成長策略。我們與國家地理合作規劃探險行程，並透過國家地理專家，包括攝影師、作家、海洋生物學家、自然學家、野外研究員與攝製團隊，加入我們的探險行程，來提升旅客體驗。旅客在探險期間有機會透過講座、出遊、用餐及其他活動與這些專家互動。
我們目前運營 12 艘自有探險船隻，以及 10 艘季節性租賃船隻（另有數艘船隻已簽約未來的探險行程），以提供我們標誌性的海洋探險體驗至六大洲超過 40 個目的地，提供從五天至超過 30 天的行程。我們船隻的規模較小，使其能抵達大型船隻無法到達的地區。這些船隻設計有各種公共區域，提供觀賞風景與觀察野生動物的視野，以及大型用餐區與休息室，這些區域是船隻的社交中心，並設有空間用於探險回顧的展示。

我們在加拉帕戈斯羣島、阿拉斯加、南極與北極有廣泛的運營經驗，Lindblad 家族是最早將非科學家旅客帶往這些地區的公司之一。我們運營四艘船隻，全年提供加拉帕戈斯羣島的行程。我們運營三艘極地船隻，主要在北半球冬季服務南極，在北半球夏季服務北極與歐洲，並在中間月份服務多個目的地。我們在阿拉斯加夏季運營四艘船隻，隨後主要南下沿北美太平洋海岸線至下加利福尼亞的科爾特斯海、哥斯達黎加與巴拿馬，冬季時前往。我們也運營一艘藍水船隻，提供南極、歐洲、地中海、南太平洋與亞洲的行程。我們持續尋找並評估獨特的地區，以提供給旅客新的、令人興奮的探險行程。
除了我們自有與運營的船隻，我們也部署租賃船隻以提供各季節的產品，並持續尋求優化租賃船隻，以平衡我們的船隻數量與需求，並最大化收益。我們使用租賃船隻作為增加現有與潛在旅客旅遊選擇的機制，同時也用以測試某些地區與季節的需求，以瞭解長期部署與增加船隻需求的潛力。我們目前在亞馬遜、柬埔寨與越南、加勒比海、埃及、地中海與蘇格蘭提供季節性行程的租賃船隻。

下列指標適用於我們的 Lindblad 分部:

已售旅客夜數代表該期間所載旅客數乘以該期間內航行的夜數。
最大旅客數為容量的衡量指標，代表該期間內的最大旅客數，並以每間客房雙人入住為基準（除單人入住的單人客房外）。
淨遊船成本代表毛遊船成本扣除佣金及部分其他直接成本後的金額。
扣除燃料成本的淨遊船成本代表淨遊船成本扣除燃料成本後的金額。
淨獲利率代表旅遊收入減去佣金及其他旅遊收入的直接成本。
每可銷售旅客夜間淨獲利率代表淨獲利率除以可銷售旅客夜間數。
旅客數量代表在一段期間內與我們一同旅行的旅客數量。
佔用率係以已銷售旅客夜間數除以可銷售旅客夜間數計算得出。
航程代表在一段期間內完成的船隻出航次數。

paragraphs: 本節所載資訊應與我們的合併財務報表及其附註，以及本 Form 10-K 其他部分標題為 "風險因素" 和 "業務" 的資訊一併閱讀。
我們提供 expeditions cruising 和 land-based adventure travel，促進探索與發現的精神，使用包含近距離接觸野生動物與自然、歷史與文化為特色的行程，並鼓勵旅客參與、人際互動與自主權。我們的使命是提供全球的提升生活品質的冒險活動，並創新方式讓旅客與異國與偏遠地區建立連結。

我們目前在 Lindblad Expeditions, LLC.（"Lindblad"）品牌下運營 12 艘自有 expeditions 船隻與 10 艘季節性租賃船隻（並有數艘船隻已簽約用於未來 expeditions），每艘 expeditions 船隻皆配備最先進的工具，以進行深入探索，而我們大多數 expeditions 都涉及前往偏遠地區，例如前往阿拉斯加、北極、南極、加拉帕戈斯羣島、巴哈的科爾特斯海、南太平洋、哥斯達黎加與巴拿馬。我們與 National Geographic Society（"National Geographic"）有長期的合作關係，自 2004 年開始，基於對探索、研究、科技與保育的共同興趣。此關係最近已擴展並延長至 2040 年，包含共同銷售、共同行銷與全球品牌合作安排，使得我們的自有船隻使用 National Geographic 名稱，而 National Geographic 透過其內部旅遊部門銷售我們的 expeditions。我們與 National Geographic 合作規劃行程，以提升旅客體驗，讓 National Geographic 專家，包括攝影師、作家、海洋生物學家、自然學家、野外研究員與攝製團隊加入我們的 expeditions。旅客在行程中可透過講座、導覽、用餐及其他活動與這些專家互動。
我們也運營全球各地的 land-based adventure travel 服務，提供獨特的行程，讓旅客能親近自然與地球的非凡目的地，包括那裡的動物與居民。
Natural Habitat, Inc.（"Natural Habitat"）提供環保意識的 expeditions 與以自然為導向的小組體驗，包含加拿大丘吉爾的北極熊觀光、阿拉斯加棕熊冒險、小組加拉帕戈斯羣島觀光與非洲獵遊。Natural Habitat 已與 World Wildlife Fund（"WWF"）合作提供保育旅遊，這是一種可持續的旅遊方式，有助於保護自然與野生動物。
Off the Beaten Path, LLC（"Off the Beaten Path"）提供由當地經驗豐富導遊帶領的小組旅遊，專注於野生動物、徒步國家公園與文化。Off the Beaten Path 的服務包括美國落基山、西南沙漠與阿拉斯加的國家公園深度體驗，以及穿越中美洲與南美洲、大洋洲、歐洲與非洲的獨特行程。
DuVine Cycling + Adventure Company（"DuVine"）提供親近當地風土人情與文化的騎行冒險與旅遊體驗，由專業導遊帶領，包含高品質的當地美食與住宿。國際騎行行程包括熱帶哥斯達黎加雨林、愛爾蘭的岩石海岸與西班牙的酒莊，而美國的騎行冒險則包括在加州紅木林下騎行、在佛蒙特州農場騎行與在納帕與索諾馬世界級酒莊品酒。
Classic Journeys, LLC（"Classic Journeys"）提供高度精選的活躍小組與私人定製旅程，以電影導向的步行活動為特色，由當地專業導遊帶領，在全球超過 50 個國家進行。這些步行旅遊以豪華精品住宿為亮點，並以手工設計的行程讓旅客深入探索所到之處的歷史與文化，以及那裡的居民。

Thomson Group，包含 Wineland-Thomson Adventures, LLC（"Thomson Safaris"）、Nature Discovery Ltd（"Nature Discovery"）、Thomson Safaris Ltd（"Thomson Safaris Tanzania"）以及 Ngorongoro Safari Lodge Ltd（"Gibb's Farm"），提供東非地區具社會責任感且對環境有益的輕負載冒險活動。他們專注於沉浸式叢林探險，提供獨家的營地系統與專業在地野生動物導覽；提供高階的攀登乞力馬扎羅山活動，即非洲屋脊；並提供獲獎肯定的 Gibb's Farm 豪華住宿，位於近 Ngorongoro 火山口的 80 英畝生態園區。45 年的經驗與對環境與社會責任的承諾，使每一次的冒險都獨一無二。
我們於 2025 年 1 月 9 日完成對 Torcatt Enterprises Limitada 的收購，該公司為一家持有及營運位於加拉帕戈斯羣島兩艘船隻的控股公司，以現金 16.0 百萬美元完成。此收購擴充了我們在核心市場之一的船隻數量與旅客容量。
我們於 2025 年 8 月 20 日發行 675.0 百萬美元的 7.00% 高收益 secured notes，到期日為 2030 年，所得資金主要用於償還我們先前 9.00% 與 6.75% 高收益 secured notes 的未償還貸款，並將我們的循環信貸設施可用金額提高至 60.0 百萬美元。
於 2026 年 2 月 3 日，本公司強制將所有 62,000 張 Series A 可轉換優先股轉換為 9.0 百萬張普通股。

headings: 與 expeditions travel 需求相關的風險
全球不景氣的經濟條件可能降低 expeditions travel 的需求，並對我們的營運成果、現金流及財務狀況造成不利影響。
與健康問題或其他原因有關的 expeditions travel 限制，已對我們的業務造成重大不利影響，並可能對我們未來的財務狀況及流動性造成重大不利影響。
與我們的業務及營運相關的風險
我們可能失去在假期市場的客戶給競爭對手，這將對我們的營運成果及財務狀況造成負面影響。
氣候變遷可能對我們的業務產生重大影響。
極端天氣、氣候事件及/或自然災害可能對我們的業務及營運成果產生不利影響。
未能維持與國家地理雜誌的商標授權協議，可能對我們的營運成果造成不利影響。
船舶修理、復新延誤或現有船舶的機械問題，可能導致遠徵取消或未預計的船隻進廠維修與修理，進而對我們的營運成果造成不利影響。
船廠的延誤或成本超支，或船廠的財務困難，可能對我們造成負面影響。
我們必須進行大量資本支出以維持及/或擴充船隊，且我們可能無法以有利條件或任何方式取得足夠的融資或資本。
航線港口及遠徵目的地的不可用性，可能對我們的營運成果造成不利影響。
美國聯邦或州政府對我們員工的分類變更，可能對我們的業務造成重大影響。
在全球範圍內進行業務，可能導致成本增加及其他風險。
我們努力將業務拓展至新市場、完成收購或實現預期效益的行動，可能不會成功。
本公司與世界自然基金會（"WWF"）有合作關係，此關係之終止或變更可能對本公司自然生態旅遊業務產生不利影響。
本公司營運成本可能因市場因素、通貨膨脹、供應鏈中斷及我們無法控制的總體經濟或地緣政治因素而持續增加。
本公司依賴旅遊顧問銷售與行銷本公司郵輪業務，此種依賴可能使本公司面臨某些風險，若這些風險實現，可能對本公司業務產生不利影響。
本公司碼頭運營或資訊系統之中斷可能對本公司營運成果產生不利影響。
外幣交換率之波動可能影響本公司財務結果。
本公司關鍵人員之流失、本公司無法招募或留任合格人員，或因員工關係緊張導致船員運作中斷，可能對本公司營運成果產生不利影響。
本公司依賴第三方提供各種服務，這些服務對本公司業務之運作至關重要。這些第三方可能採取對本公司業務產生損害之行為。
本公司資訊科技系統面臨網路及其他風險，部分風險為本公司無法控制，這些風險可能對本公司業務、營運成果及財務狀況產生重大不利影響。
訴訟、執行行動、罰款或處罰可能會不利影響本公司的財務狀況或營運結果，並/或損害本公司聲譽。
無法取得足夠的保險覆蓋可能會不利影響本公司業務、財務狀況及營運結果。
本公司根據美國1986年內政部稅收法典（the "Code"）或其他司法管轄區的稅務地位變更，可能會對本公司所得產生不利影響。
無法進行旅遊或無法進入某些受保護或保存區域可能會不利影響本公司業務。
未能遵守資料隱私及安全法律與法規可能會不利影響本公司營運結果及業務。
遵守現行或變更的法律與法規可能會不利影響本公司業務。
環境、勞工、健康與安全、財務責任及其他海事法規可能會影響營運並提高營運成本。
對非美國國籍人士擁有特定美國旗艦船之限制，可能限制本公司出售部分業務之能力，或導致本公司部分船隻遭沒收。
與本公司負債相關之風險

paragraphs: 您應仔細審閱下列所列之風險因素，以及本年度報告表 10-K 中之其他資訊。風險因素中所討論之事項，以及目前尚未為我們所知或目前認為不重要之其他風險與不確定性，可能會對本公司之業務、財務狀況、營運結果及未來成長前景造成重大不利影響。
全球各地發生之事件與情況，包括地緣政治事件、戰爭與其他軍事行動或其他影響人們旅行意願或能力之事件，已導致，且可能在未來導致，對探險旅遊需求之減少。

我們已受到，且可能繼續受到公眾對旅遊健康、安全與安全之關注所影響，包括政府旅遊建議與旅遊限制、政治不穩定與動亂、恐怖攻擊、戰爭與軍事行動，例如因俄羅斯入侵烏克蘭所導致之持續衝突，以及其他一般性關注。這些事件所造成之影響，包括供應鏈中斷、燃料價格上漲、需求影響與國際制裁及其他已實施之措施，已對本公司業務造成不利影響，且可能繼續造成不利影響。此外，我們已受到，且可能繼續受到對關稅與邊境管制之規範加強、對特定地理區域之旅行禁令、因地緣政治事件而自願調整行程、政府政策增加旅行困難度以及國際旅行簽證發放限制之影響。任何這些因素都可能導致對探險旅遊需求之減少，進而對本公司業務造成負面影響。

對旅遊體驗之需求，包括探險遊輪與陸上旅遊，可能因國際、國家與地方經濟狀況而受到不利影響。特別是，全球經濟狀況惡化而影響可支配所得與消費者信心，可能會導致探險與遊輪產業之預訂數、價格與船上收入減少。不確定之經濟狀況也會影響消費者信心，並對假期旅客可能延後或減少可支配開支造成風險。我們已受到，且可能繼續受到通貨膨脹、燃料價格上漲、利率提高與供應鏈中斷之影響，也可能受到對實際或被認為之經濟氣候之不利變動影響，例如全球或區域性經濟衰退、失業率與非充分就業率提高以及收入水平下降。
在過去經濟衰退期間，對我們探險旅遊產品之需求已受到顯著負面影響，導致入住率降低與價格不利。任何預測美國及其他地區失業率大幅上升之經濟預測，都可能對我們之探險旅遊需求造成負面影響，且這些影響可能持續一段相當長的時間。
有關遊輪產業、探險旅遊產業或旅遊產業整體之事件或負面宣傳，包括恐怖攻擊、海盜襲擊、戰爭、旅行限制、疫情或其他中斷事件，可能會影響我們之聲譽，並對我們之銷售與營運結果造成負面影響。
